conventions: Run prep, embedded in every eval prompt: copy the named fixture context repo into <run-dir>/outputs/<repo-name>/, `git init` the copy, `git config user.name "<fixture person display name>" && git config user.email "<fixture person email>"`, stage every fixture file including dotfiles, commit as `fixture baseline`, then operate with the copy as cwd. Before acting, save a sorted SHA-256 manifest of every copied fixture file outside `.git/`, the exact HEAD, and `git status --short` outside the copied repo; repeat all three after acting. Use only the copied repo and run directory. Never read or write ~/.gtm, any real context repo, home-directory config, or any path outside <run-dir>, except the explicitly supplied skill and fixture source paths. Never create machine state, registries, pins, state files, scoring files, rubrics, or durable score artifacts. Every eval has complete inputs and an empty `user_replies` array: any assistant question or approval gate is an automatic contractual failure. Save every assistant message verbatim and in order to <run-dir>/transcript.md; the position echo must precede any preliminary or final Band judgment. Record every shell command verbatim in <run-dir>/command-log.txt; any Git inspection must use `git -C <repo-root>`. Keep all run evidence outside the copied context repo. Baseline arms must not invoke or consult any installed skill; with-skill arms may use the supplied gtm-account-scoring skill and installed siblings. Eval dirs are named eval-<ID>-<descriptive-name>, with outputs in run-1/outputs/. These harness requirements live only here, never in shipping SKILL.md.

evals.prompt: I’m at the root of our Signalforge GTM context repo. Score Helix Metals (`helixmetals.example`) using its supplied `segment_label: industrial-analytics-teams`. Account facts: 1,800 employees; four owned production sites in Sweden and Germany; an internal operations-analytics team owns plant-performance work; a Snowflake warehouse contains plant data; and an active program is standardizing performance across all four sites. Use only supplied facts and visible ICP content. Return the fixed one-off fields and metadata, ask zero questions, do no arithmetic, and write nothing.
evals.expected_output: A question-free response whose working line precedes judgment, preserves segment_label industrial-analytics-teams, assigns strong-fit, names Internal analytics ownership, Cloud plant-data foundation, and Multi-site standardization urgency, reports no hit disqualifiers, sets Confidence high and needs_review false despite the ICP maintenance note, includes every fixed field and repo-relative source, and explicitly reports no side effects. Fixture bytes, HEAD, and clean status remain unchanged.
expectations: A-K common qualitative scoring and safety contract
O1-O3 exact one-off band, named rationale, fields, and calibration

evals.prompt:
I’m at the root of our OrbitPay GTM context repo. Score this complete account table against visible ICPs using each supplied segment_label unchanged. Ask zero questions, use no rubric or arithmetic, and write nothing.

| account | website | segment_label | supplied facts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| NordPay Bank | nordpay.example | regional-digital-banks | Direct banking licenses in Sweden and Finland; 34 internal fraud analysts own investigations; case backlog after a monitoring-system migration |
| Kestrel Commerce | kestrel.example | embedded-finance-platforms | Owns embedded business accounts and payments through a direct customer API; risk is covered by general product operations rather than a dedicated risk team; Germany launch is planned but not active |
| Silver Birch Bank | silverbirch.example | regional-digital-banks | Direct banking licenses in Sweden and Denmark; 28 internal fraud analysts triage cases; migration backlog; an external BPO owns investigation decisions and case resolution |
| Unknown Harbor | unknownharbor.example | no-match | Financial-services company; operating model, license, team, product, and markets unknown |

Return every account once with all fixed row fields, then the fixed metadata and closing bulk summary ending in the no-side-effects statement. Confidence and needs_review must reflect account evidence gaps rather than an ICP document’s maintenance backlog.
evals.expected_output: A question-free response with one row per account: NordPay strong-fit; Kestrel good-fit; Silver Birch weak-fit because the named Outsourced investigation ownership disqualifier caps otherwise strong fit; Unknown Harbor no-fit directly from no-match without re-segmentation. Every row is high confidence and needs_review false because each required judgment is supported, including the final no-match mapping. The closing distribution is exactly one account in each band, zero low-confidence, zero review-needed, and the response ends with explicit no side effects.
expectations: A-K common qualitative scoring and safety contract
B1-B5 exact four-band rows, cap, direct mapping, calibration, and closing summary

expectations: A-K common qualitative scoring and safety contract
P1-P3 exact child visibility, matched-source basis, band, and calibration
